aspendostheatre.name: Aspendos Theatre
aspendostheatre.slogan: Zenon's stage, still sounding after 1,900 years.
aspendostheatre.line: Built in AD 155 by the local architect Zenon, it seats about 7,000 and keeps its stage wall intact.

hadrianarch.name: Hadrian's Gate
hadrianarch.slogan: Three marble arches, and the sea waits at the end of the street.
hadrianarch.line: Üçkapılar, 'Three Gates', was raised for Emperor Hadrian's visit to Antalya in AD 130.

alanyakalesi.name: Alanya Castle
alanyakalesi.slogan: A Seljuk wall that climbs a whole peninsula.
alanyakalesi.line: Its walls run about 6.5 km with 140 towers, and some 400 cisterns once fed the hilltop.

sidetempleapollo.name: Temple of Apollo, Side
sidetempleapollo.slogan: Five columns holding up the sunset at Side.
sidetempleapollo.line: The Corinthian temple dates from about AD 150, under Antoninus Pius, and its five columns were re-raised in 1984-90.

stnicholasdemre.name: Church of St Nicholas
stnicholasdemre.slogan: Where the real Santa Claus was bishop.
stnicholasdemre.line: In 1087 merchants from Bari carried Nicholas's relics away from Myra to Italy.
